claims.explanation: AZD7762 inhibits Chk1/2, abrogating the S/G2 DNA-damage checkpoints and homologous recombination. Cells with a defective G1 checkpoint (e.g., TP53 mutation) and/or high oncogenic replication stress (PIK3CA, EGFR, PTEN, MYC activation) rely on Chk1 for survival and are selectively killed, while cells without these features survive.
